entities.summary: Vera Fyodorovna Schmidt or Shmidt was a Russian and Soviet psychoanalyst and educationist. She was one of the leading figures in the psychoanalytic movement during the "Silver Age". After the 1917 Russian Revolution, she directed a highly innovative nursery school run on psychoanalytic principles.
